page.overview:
Who is Oran?

Oran was the husband of Roji, the father of Mizuira, the younger brother of Nico Olvia, and the maternal uncle and foster parent of Nico Robin.

Oran had black hair in a combover, a thin curled mustache, and slight stubble on his chin. He wore glasses along with a collared shirt, sweater, and bowtie.

Oran was a generally absent father figure for Robin. Although he tried to comfort Robin when her mother sailed and defended her from his wife's abuse, he rarely defied Roji's temper and let her treat Robin as if she were their servant, despite his older sister asked him to take care of her precious daughter.

28 years ago, Oran agreed, against his wife's wishes, to look after his niece Robin. He saw his sister Olvia off at the harbor when she left on her voyage, and tried to comfort Robin. When Roji angrily threatened to hit Robin if she did not cease crying, Oran stopped his wife.
